# Finance Tool Hub

> Finance Tool Hub is a collection of fast, accurate, and user-friendly financial calculators and digital tools designed to help individuals manage budgets, loans, investments, and financial planning efficiently.

## Core Financial Tools

- [Loan & EMI Calculator](https://financetoolhub.online/): Calculate your monthly loan installments, interest breakdowns, and repayment schedules instantly.
- [Investment & Savings Calculator](https://financetoolhub.online/): Plan your future growth, compound interest, and wealth accumulation. (Update with your specific sub-page URL)
- [Tax & Budget Calculator](https://financetoolhub.online/): Estimate taxes and manage personal cash flow smoothly. (Update with your specific sub-page URL)
